pitch.oneLiner: Know exactly which houseplants need water today, and keep every one of them alive.
pitch.audience: Houseplant owners with 3–30 plants who want simple, reliable care guidance.
pitch.coreLoop: Open Today, water what's due with one tap, keep the streak alive, glance at the week ahead.
pitch.differentiator: Per-plant intervals with type presets, a care streak, fully offline with zero setup.

features.title: Add & edit plants
features.description: Add a plant with a name, room and plant type. The type preset fills in a sensible watering interval that you can adjust from 1 to 60 days.
acceptance: Choosing a preset sets the interval
Saved plant appears in My Plants and Today/Upcoming
Plants can be edited and deleted

features.title: Today list
features.description: See every plant that is due or overdue, most urgent first, and mark it watered with one tap.
acceptance: Overdue plants show how many days late
Tapping Water logs a watering, plays a haptic and removes it from the list
Empty state celebrates when everything is watered

features.title: Plant detail & history
features.description: Each plant shows its next due date, interval, room, and a history of past waterings.
acceptance: Water now button logs a watering

features.title: Care streak
features.description: A streak counts consecutive days on which every due plant was watered.
acceptance: Streak increments when all due plants are watered for the day
Streak resets after a day with missed plants

features.title: Upcoming week
features.description: The next 7 days of watering, grouped by day.
acceptance: Groups plants by due day for the next 7 days
Days with nothing due are omitted

features.title: Watering reminders
features.description: A daily local notification when plants are due.

journeys.title: Water a due plant from Today
steps: Tap Water on the first due plant
Plant leaves the due list and streak is visible

journeys.title: Open a plant and see history
steps: See next due date and watering history

design.tone: Calm, warm and encouraging; botanical greens, rounded cards

nativeValue: Haptic feedback on watering and streak milestones
Fully offline local storage — works with no connection
Native tab navigation, SF Symbols and dark mode
Fast one-tap daily routine designed for the home screen habit
